project_type: Nim DSL compiler and web framework (Doot)
build_system: nimble with nim.cfg (--threads:on --mm:orc, db_connector path). Binary target named 'doot'.
test_framework: Nim stdlib unittest module. Test files in tests/ directory named test_*.nim. Each compiled separately with nim c -r.
build_command: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c src/doot.nim
test_command: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH && cd /projects/sandbox/Doot && nim c -r tests/test_cli.nim
verification_instructions: 1. Compile src/doot.nim successfully. 2. Run tests/test_cli.nim and confirm all tests pass. 3. Verify that 'doot new testapp' creates the expected directory structure. 4. Verify 'doot help' outputs command list.
setup_instructions: export PATH=/root/.nimble/bin:$PATH - Nim 2.2.10 is installed via choosenim at /root/.nimble/bin
environment_constraints: Nim available at /root/.nimble/bin. No Docker. OPEN_INTERNET network. Libraries available: std lib only (no mummy). db_connector bundled with Nim at /root/.choosenim/toolchains/nim-2.2.10/pkgs/db_connector/src. argon2 and openssl C libs available for linking.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Comprehensive unit tests. Phase exit criteria must all pass.
key_patterns: Each module is a single .nim file in src/doot/. Types defined at top, procs below. Tests use unittest suites. Exported procs marked with *. Modules import from same directory (e.g., 'import ast' not 'import ../doot/ast'). Parser uses parseWithErrors returning (ast, errors). Token constructors via newToken. Schema changes detected via migration_diff.diffSchema comparing current schema AST to loadSnapshot result.
directory_structure: src/doot.nim is the main entry point (binary). src/doot/ contains all modules. tests/ contains test files. examples/blog/ is the reference project. docs/ has specs.
